[b][size=5]Using crab pots to decorate the water of lakes, ocean and rivers!
[/size][/b][size=3]Adds 100+ textures in total.[/size]

[size=3]Maybe the original texture isn't really aesthetically pleasing to you and you keep your crabpots out of the farm. But some texture changes can bring a little bit of life for your waters. [/size]

[size=3]This mod is heavily inspired by zilchaz's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6346]Duck Crab Pot[/url], so I highly recomend checking it out too.[/size]

[size=3][b]The crabpots work normally. This is only an aesthetic[/b]﻿[/size][b][size=3] change.[/size]

[/b][size=5]You'll [b]NEED [/b]PeacefulEnd's [/size][size=5][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] for this mod to work.[/size][size=3]
The cool thing about AT is that it is so simple to use and you can use as many possible textures you can, instead of only one. Consider supporting them, too.

[/size]

º ° º ° º ° º ° º ° º ° º ° º ° º ° º ° º ° º ° º ° º ° º ° º ° º ° º ° º ° º ° º ° º ° º ° º ° º ° º ° º ° º ° º ° º ° º ° 



[b][size=5]HOW TO INSTALL:[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=3] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/size]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative textures[/url][/size]
[*][size=3]Download the mod .zip/.rar document[/size]
[*][size=3]Export the compressed file[/size]
[*][size=3]Move the exported file to your Mods folder﻿﻿[/size]
[/list]
[size=3]Check out [/size][url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started]SMAPI Player Guide[/url][size=3] in case of any questions.[/size]



[b][size=5]﻿HOW TO USE:[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Purchase the "Paint Bucket" item from Robin (and the other AT tools if you feel so)
[*]Use the Paint Bucket by left-clicking on the crabpot
[*]Choose a texture
[*]Done!
[/list]

[b][size=5]I'M OPEN TO SUGGESTIONS![/size]
[/b][size=3]If you have an texture idea, feel free to tell me! If it's viable, i'll probably add it.

[/size][size=3]Please, beware that I'm a complete newbie to mod making, and for now I'm just experimenting new stuff.
[/size]
Thank you so much for using my mod! Please, share your screenshots and opinions (as well as bugs).
